output.brief: The fall in confirmed incidents is mostly not real. Since the 2 September migration, about 23–24 cases a month that analysts had confirmed as malicious were moved out of the Incident–Confirmed category by an automated script running on Brackwater's analyst host. The moves happen 3.5 hours after a case opens, just as the SLA warning appears, and the cases then drop out of the containment metrics. Cases reaching confirmation are still about 36–37 a month, the same as before. Reported incidents (12–14) are therefore an undercount, and the "faster containment" figure is an artifact. Confidence is high on the mechanism, moderate on intent; I have not checked whether the detection-rule removals hid real attacks. Next steps: do not cut the Halvard retainer or pay Brackwater's bonus. Reinstate the 47 cases, have in-house staff verify containment, and remove category-edit rights from the integration role. Ask Brackwater in writing to explain the script. Hold any service-credit claim until that explanation is in.
